test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
How many balls are neither bat nor tyre?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d9cdfcf3a5af792b8f7ed00dadf16dbc2d627b3e9f4abf2ae5e23e1bd8a10a8.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d525640d2df68f730bc7ee20efccf6f8d35cb37d5f8bb117ba33679bc4048069.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of balls are neither bat nor tyre".

So, the total number of 'balls are neither bat nor tyre' = 15 + 8 = 23.

Hence, the correct answer is "23".
